About.title: About EduVice
About.lead: EduVice helps immigrant parents understand how schools work in the United States, in plain language and in their own language.
About.whyBody: The US school system can be confusing, even for families who grew up here. Words like IEP, GPA, and school district can be hard to understand, and many parents don't know the rights their family has, like the right to enroll without a Social Security number or to have a free interpreter. EduVice puts clear answers in one place.
About.principle1Body: EduVice is free to use, with no account needed.
About.principle2Body: We never ask about immigration status. Accounts are optional: without one, your chats stay on your own device.
About.principle3Body: When our reviewed school guide covers a question, answers use it and show the source.
About.principle4Body: Every question is a good question, in any language.
About.limitsBody: EduVice gives general information, not legal advice. Rules can differ by state and school district, so check important details with your child's school. For questions about your own immigration situation, talk to a qualified immigration lawyer or a nonprofit legal aid organization.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: EduVice is a free information website for parents. This policy explains what happens to information when you use it.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: You don't need an account to use EduVice, and we never ask about immigration status. When you ask a question, we receive the text of your question. To stop abuse, we keep a scrambled (hashed) version of your internet address together with a count of how many questions were asked. These counts are deleted automatically within 24 hours.

sections.heading: If you create an account
sections.body: Accounts are optional. If you sign in, we store your email address, your name if you give it, and, if you sign in with Google, your profile picture. If you choose a password, we store only a scrambled (hashed) version of it, never the password itself. Your chats with Marg are saved to your account in our database so you can see them on any device. You can delete any chat, or delete your whole account and all its chats, at any time from the account menu.

sections.heading: How your questions are answered
sections.body: To answer your question, we send its text to Google's Gemini service, which helps find the right topic and write the answer. When a question needs current or specific information, Gemini may also use Google Search; for questions about which colleges give credit for AP exams, it searches only College Board and official college websites. Google processes this text under its own terms and may store it and use it to improve its services. Please don't include names, addresses, case numbers, or other personal details in your questions.

sections.heading: What we don't do
sections.body: We don't sell your information, show ads, or use tracking cookies. If you don't sign in, we don't save your conversations on our servers: so that Marg can remember your conversation, your chat history is stored only in your own browser on your device. Tap "New chat" to delete it at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use a cookie to remember the language you chose. If you sign in, we also use cookies to keep you signed in. We don't use cookies for tracking or advertising.

sections.heading: Hosting
sections.body: Like most websites, our hosting provider may keep basic technical logs, such as internet address and browser type, for security and to keep the site running.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: EduVice is made for parents and guardians. It is not designed for children under 13 to use on their own.

sections.heading: Changes and questions
sections.body: If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page. If you have questions, please contact us.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.intro: By using EduVice, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Information only
sections.body: EduVice provides general information about US schools. It is not legal, medical, or immigration advice. Rules differ by state and school district, so confirm important details with your child's school or a qualified professional.

sections.heading: Answers can be wrong
sections.body: Answers are written with the help of artificial intelligence, using our school guide when it applies. We work to keep them accurate, but they may be incomplete, out of date, or wrong. Don't rely on EduVice alone for important decisions.

sections.heading: Fair use
sections.body: Please use EduVice respectfully. Don't try to break, overload, or misuse the website, or collect its content with automated tools. We limit how many questions can be asked in a short time.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: EduVice is provided "as is", without guarantees of any kind. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for losses that come from using the website.

sections.heading: Other websites
sections.body: EduVice may mention other websites or organizations. We don't control them and aren't responsible for their content.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. If we do, we will change the date at the top of this page.
